spec.title: Network Observability - Change Intelligence and Discovery Health
spec.description: What changed in the global network, and whether the monitoring that tells us is healthy: topology changes and conflicts, software and reboot drift, and discovery module, walker and credential health across every exporter.

panels.title: Exporter summary

options.content:
{{#each data}}
{{exporter}}{{#if stale}}GRAPH STALE{{else}}GRAPH FRESH{{/if}}
{{devices}}devices
{{links}}links
{{vendors}}vendors
{{faults}}modules not OK
{{chg_range}}changes in range
{{chg_total}}changes since start
{{cycle_p95}}scycle p95
{{/each}}
options.defaultContent: No exporter data in the selected range.

panels.description: One card per selected discovery exporter. Devices and links come from the live topology graph, changes from network_topology_change_total, cycle p95 from the discovery cycle duration histogram, and modules not OK from network_topology_module_last_status.

panels.title: Links discovered

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="network-topology-exporter", instance=~"$exporter"} | logfmt | event="topology_change" | change_kind="added" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Topology change log lines with change_kind=added over the selected range (Loki, network-topology-exporter stream).

panels.title: Links lost

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="network-topology-exporter", instance=~"$exporter"} | logfmt | event="topology_change" | change_kind="removed" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Topology change log lines with change_kind=removed over the selected range. Removed edges are logged at warn level.

panels.title: Neighbour conflicts
panels.description: Conflict log lines (conflict_type=neighbour_disagreement) where two discovery protocols disagree about the same adjacency.

panels.title: Spokes up
panels.description: Federation spokes currently pushing to the global hub (network_topology_federation_spoke_up == 1).

panels.title: Spokes down
panels.description: Federation spokes that have missed their liveness window.

panels.title: Hub updates rejected
panels.description: Spoke graph pushes refused by the hub (size budget, invalid labels, structural or stale generation) over the selected range.

panels.title: Topology changes by kind and protocol (metrics)
panels.description: increase() of network_topology_change_total per interval, stacked by change_kind and discovery_proto across the selected exporters. Counter resets on exporter restart are handled by increase().

panels.title: Change events logged by kind and protocol
panels.description: Topology change log lines from the network-topology-exporter stream, counted per interval from the logfmt body fields change_kind and proto (the stream labels only carry the dominant kind for each batch).

panels.title: Cumulative changes since exporter start
panels.description: Raw network_topology_change_total grouped by protocol and kind: includes the initial discovery of every adjacency when each exporter started.

panels.title: Change and conflict events
panels.description: Raw topology_change and topology_conflict events (logfmt) from the exporters. Expand a line to see structured fields: src_device, src_port, dst_device, dst_port, direction, change_kind and proto.

panels.title: Software versions per vendor

targets.expr: 100 * count by (vendor, os_version)(network_topology_device_info{instance=~"$exporter"}) / on (vendor) group_left() sum by (vendor)(count by (vendor, os_version)(network_topology_device_info{instance=~"$exporter"}))

panels.description: Devices per vendor and OS version across the selected exporters. Share is the fraction of that vendor's devices on the version; orange marks a minority version (under 50% of the vendor) that deserves a drift review.

panels.title: Devices per vendor by OS version
panels.description: Stacked device counts: one bar per vendor, one segment per OS version in use. More than one segment in a bar means that vendor is running mixed software.

panels.title: Shortest uptime - recent reboots

targets.expr: max by (exporter, device_id, vendor, os_version)(label_replace(bottomk(10, network_topology_device_uptime_seconds{instance=~"$exporter"}) * on (instance, device_id) group_left (vendor, os_version) network_topology_device_info{instance=~"$exporter"}, "exporter", "$1", "instance", "netobs-(.*):9100"))

panels.description: The ten devices with the lowest sysUpTime (network_topology_device_uptime_seconds joined to device_info). Red means rebooted within 24 hours, orange within 7 days.

panels.title: Devices rebooted in last 24h
panels.description: Devices whose sysUpTime is under 24 hours.

panels.title: Vendors on mixed software
panels.description: Vendors running more than one OS version across the selected exporters.

panels.title: Median device uptime
panels.description: Median sysUpTime across the selected exporters.

panels.title: Fleet size under review
panels.description: Devices counted in the drift and uptime panels above.

panels.title: Discovery module status
panels.description: network_topology_module_last_status per exporter and discovery module: 0 OK, 1 Degraded, 2 Hard-failed.

panels.title: Module health map
panels.description: Worst module status over the selected range, one hexagon per exporter and module. Green is OK, orange degraded, red hard-failed.

panels.title: Module duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of network_topology_discovery_module_duration_seconds over the last 10 minutes, per exporter and module.

panels.title: SNMP walk success
panels.description: Share of SNMP walks with status=ok (network_topology_snmp_walks_total, 5 minute rate) per exporter.

panels.title: SNMP session pool hit ratio

targets.expr: max by (exporter)(label_replace(sum by (instance)(rate(network_topology_snmp_session_pool_hits_total{instance=~"$exporter"}[5m])) / (sum by (instance)(rate(network_topology_snmp_session_pool_hits_total{instance=~"$exporter"}[5m])) + sum by (instance)(rate(network_topology_snmp_session_pool_misses_total{instance=~"$exporter"}[5m]))) * 100, "exporter", "$1", "instance", "netobs-(.*):9100"))

panels.description: Share of SNMP session requests served from the pool without re-establishing a session (hits / (hits + misses), 5 minute rate).

panels.title: Credential trial outcomes
panels.description: SNMP credential trials over the selected range (network_topology_credential_trials_total), split by exporter and outcome. Any non-ok slice indicates devices rejecting the configured credentials.

panels.title: Walker outcomes
panels.description: Walk results per protocol walker over the selected range, stacked by outcome (edges, no_neighbours, mib_unimplemented, walker_drift, error). BGP vendor walkers are included.

panels.title: Discovery cycle p95
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of a full discovery cycle per exporter.

panels.title: SNMP rate-limit wait p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time a poll spent blocked on the per-device SNMP rate limiter.

panels.title: Cycle budget skips
panels.description: Devices skipped because a discovery cycle exhausted its time budget (network_topology_cycle_budget_skips_total) over the selected range. Anything above zero means discovery is falling behind.
